# S59 — Decisions screen: open and decided records, one project or all

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

The owner needs to see each project's decisions: the open questions first, with their options and recommendation, and the decided records. The screen covers one project or all projects. It is read-only. This slice is the split-out Decisions half of the former S12 (owner choice, 2026-10-20).

Decision 120 (ui.views, decided) makes Tab and Shift+Tab switch views (Overview, Roadmap, Decisions), so the screen is a view. Decided records sit on a second tab (docs/dashboard.md:227-233).

The data is already in the project snapshot: Open from `adj inbox --json` and Decided from `adj list --json --status decided` (source.go:72-73, :103-105, :135-140; adjcli.go:82, :88). The adjcli.Record type carries options, recommendation, decision, rationale and history (adjcli.go:37-54), and the list fixture has them (testdata/cli/adj/list.json). So Enter on a record needs no new adj call.

## Failing tests

- TestDecisionsListsOpenFirstWithOptionsAndRecommendation: open records come first, each with its options and recommendation.
- TestDecisionsSecondTabListsDecided: the second tab lists decided records.
- TestDecisionsAllProjectsMergesAdjProjectsOnly: the all-projects view merges projects with adj true; each row names its project.
- TestDecisionsNoAdjProject: a project with adj false shows "no adj in this project".
- TestDecisionsEnterShowsRecordFromSnapshot: Enter shows the record with no adj call (the Live fake and the source fake record no calls).
- TestDecisionsWritesNothing: no key on the screen writes anything.
- A failed inbox or list call shows its error row verbatim and keeps the other rows.
- Golden views at 100x30, colour and monochrome.
